body: - G-Cfg-1: reconcile_manual_merge_main emits RECONCILE_STATUS=ok and RECONCILE_STATUS=failed as hardcoded string literals (4 call sites) without corresponding Final constants in config.py. The parallel waiver flow correctly uses config.ASSESSMENT_WAIVER_STATUS_OK and config.ASSESSMENT_WAIVER_STATUS_FAILED for its analogous WAIVER_STATUS key, but no RECONCILE_STATUS_OK, RECONCILE_STATUS_FAILED, or RECONCILE_STATUS_KEY constant is defined. RECONCILE_STATUS is a machine-consumed stdout KV key (the verb is listed in _MACHINE_STDOUT_KEYS in cli.py), making its key name and values wire literals that G-Cfg-1 requires to be defined once as Finals. All other new config literals (ASSESSMENT_OPERATOR_WAIVER_FILENAME, ASSESSMENT_OPERATOR_WAIVER_SCHEMA_VERSION, ASSESSMENT_WAIVER_KINDS, TERMINAL_DONE_CLEAR_FIELDS, RECONCILE_TERMINAL_DONE_CLEAR_FIELDS) are properly centralized.
